review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.decision: Require evidence newer than the selected model before sharing effort across snapshots
review.notes: Independent review of e891f65a found a legacy-only A to B to A sequence between current observations. Exercise actual legacy change semantics and current reads in a disposable HOME. Preserve the existing reset and effort-only regressions.

cases.description: Returning to a model does not restore effort from its previous selection
cases.setup: Use a disposable HOME with both profile generations initially observing A, and a recorded effort in the current generation.
cases.action: Only the legacy writer changes model from A to B and back to A without effort. Then it records a new effort without refreshing the model.
cases.expected: Both model changes leave effort empty even when the current generation still records the old A effort. The later effort is accepted under the latest A selection.
